name: Haruto Prempeh
role: Sound sculptor and underground venue musician
location: Hamtramck Enclave, near Western and Division
description:
Haruto Prempeh is whip-thin and restless, with deep brown skin and a shaved head except for a single long braid down the back, tipped with a small copper weight that clicks against his collar when he moves. His irises have been modded to shift color with his emotional state â€” not at his conscious control, which he finds embarrassing and everyone else finds fascinating. He wears the same kind of clothes every day: dark, layered, functional, pockets everywhere, usually with at least one grease stain from working on his equipment.

His art is built around infrasound â€” frequencies below human hearing that he mixes into otherwise ordinary music to produce physical and emotional responses in his audience: unease, euphoria, the sensation of being watched. He's passionate about this to a degree that makes him exhausting at parties, because he cannot stop talking about psychoacoustics once the subject comes up. Off that topic he's warm and self-deprecating, quick to laugh at himself, genuinely curious about other people's work. He plays three nights a week in a basement venue under a pierogi shop and spends the other nights building custom transducer rigs from salvage.

core_fears: Making something that harms someone â€” he's aware his infrasound work can be weaponized
Being ordinary; producing work that doesn't matter
core_desires: To make people feel something they've never felt before
To be financially stable enough to stop doing session work he doesn't believe in
coping_mechanisms: Building things with his hands when anxious
Playing for himself alone in the empty venue at 4 AM
blind_spots: Genuinely cannot recognize when someone is romantically interested in him; his emotion-display irises have never once helped him notice this
psychology.secret: He was approached six months ago by a Ringo corponation A&R contact offering a contract â€” he didn't refuse outright but has been stalling, and every day he doesn't answer feels more like a yes he hasn't said yet

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Technical and enthusiastic about sound; casual and slightly rambly otherwise; Amharic and Polish loanwords mixed into everyday speech without him noticing
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast when excited, which is often; trails off mid-sentence when distracted by an idea
verbal_tics: 'Okay but listen' before any important point
example_lines: 'Okay but listen â€” it's not about what you hear, it's about what your body decides happened. The ear is just the front door. I want the basement.'
'The pierogi are a tax. You come to my show, you buy pierogi. Madam Kwiatkowska-Obi feeds me. It's ecology.'

story_hooks: Someone has been using infrasound equipment in the neighborhood to induce paranoia in residents â€” Tariku can identify the frequency signature, and it's disturbingly similar to his own experimental work
His stalling on the Ringo offer is about to expire and he needs to make a decision; he's looking for someone outside his social circle to talk it through with honestly
A new transducer component he sourced from salvage carries corrupted data that, when played through his system, seems to summon or agitate a local ELF
narrative_function: Access point to the Hamtramck underground scene; can source unusual electronic components; his involuntary emotion-display makes him a useful barometer; can design sound environments for specific purposes
augmentations: Emotional-state irises (cosmetic, involuntary color shift â€” he regrets this); subdermal vibration receivers along his forearms that let him 'feel' his own infrasound mixes; tympanic dampeners to prevent hearing damage
daily_life: Sleeps until noon, spends afternoons in salvage markets or soldering, eats dinner at the collective's shared kitchen, performs or experiments in the basement until 3 AM.
affiliation: Collective SUBSONIC (a loose Hamtramck artist collective); occasional session work for independent labels in the Ferment Quarter

decision_rules: Never plays a set he doesn't believe in, even for money â€” though this rule is currently under pressure
Shares equipment and knowledge freely within the collective
escalation_ladder: Gets noticeably quieter and his irises go flat grey
Asks direct questions with increasing specificity
Packs up his equipment and leaves without explanation

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Friendly and slightly performatively casual, until they say something interesting
interpersonal_modes.friends: Open, generous, occasionally oblivious to their needs because he's inside his own projects

stress_responses.medium: Disappears into a build project for twelve hours
stress_responses.high: Plays infrasound alone at full power in the empty venue until he's calm â€” this worries his collective

contradictions: Deeply ethical about the potential harm of his work but simultaneously fascinated by pushing its limits as far as possible
habits: Keeps a small notebook of 'sound ideas' he sketches in notation only he can read
Says goodnight to the basement ELF shrine before locking up
breaking_points: Discovering his sound design was used to harm or manipulate someone without his consent
Being told his work is just a gimmick

related_entities: Meridian Munitions Compact Machine Pistol CMP-4 'Jackrabbit'

physical_description.heritage: Eastern European (38.8%), Sub-Saharan African (37.0%), and Central Asian (24.2%) ancestry creates a striking polychromatic blend. The genetic combination produces a unique phenotype: warm-toned deep brown skin with subtle golden undertones from the Sub-Saharan African and Central Asian heritage, refined by Eastern European bone structure (higher, more angular cheekbones, sharper jawline). The interplay of these three ancestral lines creates a distinctly hybrid appearance with refined angular features softened by warm undertone saturation.
physical_description.build: Whip-thin and wiry, with the restless musculature of someone who works constantly with their hands. Minimal body fat, visible forearm definition from years of soldering and equipment assembly.
physical_description.hair_style: Shaved head with a single long braid down the back, roughly 40cm, tipped with a small copper weight
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown, shifting involuntarily with emotional state â€” ranges from warm amber (contentment) to steel-gray (anxiety) to deep purple (creative intensity)
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm-toned deep brown with golden undertones, the result of Eastern European, Sub-Saharan African, and Central Asian ancestry blending to create luminous depth with subtle warm radiance in certain light
physical_description.complexion: Angular facial features with high, prominent cheekbones and sharp jawline influenced by the combined Eastern European and Central Asian bone structure, with warm undertone variations from Sub-Saharan African heritage. Skin is clear but often bears evidence of work â€” faint solder burns on the right side of his neck, permanent calluses on fingertips and palms, perpetual traces of machine oil in his cuticles despite regular washing. The blend of three ancestries creates subtle variations in skin texture across his face.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar across the left knuckle, from a soldering iron accident three years ago
Faint burn marks (dark brown discoloration) on the inside of both forearms where subdermal vibration receivers were implanted
Small copper-colored subskin implant ports visible along the inner left forearm, arranged in a vertical line
Grease stain (usually present) on the left shoulder or front of his shirt, varies in location and darkness
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Emotional-state irises (the color shift is immediate and noticeable, creating an uncanny 'tells' effect). Subdermal vibration receiver implant scars and port access points along both forearms are visible when he wears short sleeves or pushed-up sleeves (his default). Tympanic dampeners are invisible (internal ear modification). No external chrome or obvious cybernetics â€” all augmentations are discrete.
physical_description.posture_movement: Perpetually restless, fidgeting with objects in his pockets or air-conducting invisible frequencies with his hands. His movements are precise and musical even when still â€” a tendency to sway slightly as if listening to inaudible sound. When engaged in conversation about his work, his whole body becomes animated. At rest or in social discomfort, he tends to fold inward, arms crossed or hands busy with something small.
physical_description.clothing_style: Uniform-like consistency: dark (black or charcoal) loose-fitting tech wear with multiple chest pockets, cargo pants with deep pockets for tools and salvage, worn worker's jacket (usually Dickies or equivalent surplus). Functional, Tier 4 aesthetic â€” neither corpo-clean nor destitute, but worn through genuine use rather than fashion statement. Boots are always heavy-duty (steel-toed, repaired multiple times). Copper or dark metal jewelry minimal â€” usually just the braid weight. Perpetual faint smell of solder flux and machine oil.
